name: Manta Ray
role: Second respect point, the attractor. Brings 8-12 small followers that tighten when a Shark is near.
home: Half the screen; never the Shark lane
habit: Every other wave. Meets the Shark about 1 visit in 3 (only through the Shark gate). Never flees, never speeds past 1.3x.

routes.name: Grand arc
routes.purpose: Covers most of the screen. In a meeting no Shark lane fits, so the Shark waits off screen.

routes.name: Open glide
routes.purpose: Straight glide in the top or bottom half; leaves the other half free.

routes.name: Slow S
routes.purpose: Middle-to-low S; only the far edge is left for a meeting Shark.

routes.name: Feeding loop
routes.purpose: Circles one side; followers bunch around it.

routes.name: Seat row glide
routes.purpose: Glides along a seat row; that row gets the followers up close.
